# Pinned XARF schemas

These files are test-only copies of the official XARF JSON Schemas. They make
schema validation deterministic and independent of network availability.

- XARF v3: `abusix/xarf` commit `56b4d98c6e9e375faf455ab5728e735081803ef1`
- XARF v4: `xarf/xarf-spec` commit `ca7497e8e53c0bf4a0fc2492700abf0277cf91f1`

The schemas remain under their upstream licenses. Update the pinned commit and
the validation tests together when adopting a newer schema revision.
